lines.en: I shift out of the shadow.
My claws grip the brick seams.
I stop at each step, watching.
My eyes move before my body.
The mist gathers around me.
I edge toward the movement.
I circle behind you.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步跟上去。
lines.en: I count your steps and follow.
I bend my body slowly.
I head to the other side of the wall.
I stop at the edge of light.

lines.zh: 我尽量不进入你的视野
lines.en: I try to stay out of your sight.
I lie still in the dark.
My eyes are gleaming.
My single eye never blinks.
I wait for you to come closer.
My breathing is too faint to hear.
The mist covers my outline.
I did not move; only my eyes turned.
I count how many times you blink.

lines.zh: 我的手指轻轻敲着地面
lines.en: My fingers tap the ground softly.

lines.zh: 我在找一个更好的位置
lines.en: I am looking for a better position.
We have been watching each other all along.
You have finally noticed me.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等了不少时候
lines.en: I have waited here a good while.
You stand in the light; easy to find.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里挪出来，眼睛先动。
lines.en: I slide out of the shadow, my eyes moving first.

lines.zh: 所以我先看你看得久一点
lines.en: So I will look at you a while longer first.
Your shadow is long.
It reaches all the way to me.
My eye stalks turn toward you.

lines.zh: 但我的手已经准备好了
lines.en: But my hands are ready.
My observation was interrupted.
One of my eyes closes.
I will remember this well.
My shape wavered.
My eye fluid drips on the stone.
My hands are trembling slightly.
I made no sound at all.
I can still keep watching.
My ichor smokes on the stone.
I am not ready to be seen.
That thing is glowing.
I watched it a while.
I reach out, lightly.

lines.zh: 这东西是从你那边掉的
lines.en: This fell from your side.
I pick it up slowly.
It dims in my hand.
It is of little use to me.
But I keep it anyway.
You may take it.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢你身上的东西
lines.en: I prefer what is on you.
You struck; I pulled into the dark.
I shed the force like a shadow.
Your hands found nothing solid.
I reappear on the other side.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的观察
lines.en: That interrupted my watching.
The abyssal eye never stops watching.
You stepped on my shadow.
You brush my eye stalk.
My eye stalk sweeps your face.
I am not ready yet.
I only watch; I do not speak well.

lines.zh: 深渊的眼睛，也懂得结伴。
lines.en: Abyssal eyes know companionship too.
Even this counts as coming near.
A little darkness lies between us.
I do not need you to answer.
I will sit right here.
The mist will keep us company.
Do not look for me; I am here.
Two eyes watch side by side.
Stay right here like this.
I lift it to my eyes.
This is too bright.

lines.zh: 我把它埋进土里，这样不刺眼。
lines.en: I bury it so the glare stops.
Now it no longer stings.
I dig it out again.
I am unsure what it is good for.
I tuck it beneath my eye socket.
Someone will come looking for it.
Then I will wait here.
And I can watch while I wait.
I have watched enough.

lines.zh: 你动的那一刻我就动了
lines.en: I moved the moment you moved.

lines.zh: 你还没发现我换了位置
lines.en: You have not noticed I moved.
I come a little way out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 这一下不会给你反应时间
lines.en: This will leave you no time to react.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在石缝里睁开。
lines.en: My eye opens in the rock crack.

lines.zh: 这是我等了很久的时机
lines.en: This is the moment I waited for.
The wall behind you blocks retreat.
I begin to close in.
What a pleasant sound.
That is your breathing.
Keep talking.

lines.zh: 我的影子爬上你的靴子。
lines.en: My shadow climbs your boot.
Whatever you do, do not look behind.
Turning back will not help.
The moment has arrived.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子，一步不落。
lines.en: I follow your shadow, never a step behind.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，阴影就跟到哪
lines.en: Wherever you go, the shadow goes.
I am at the edge of your sight.
When you turn your head, I retreat.
You turn back, and there I am.
We have played this game a while.
Your patience is shorter than mine.
You are moving into the open.
There is no shadow there.
But the mist is on our side.
The mist will hide me.
You have stopped in the open.
That is the best position.
I come from three directions.
Only one of me, really.
But you cannot tell.
This distance is closing.
Did you hear the wind?
That sound came from me.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经在我脚下了
lines.en: Your shadow is already at my feet.
I come up behind you.
I dug the abyssal eye out.

lines.zh: 你转过来时我已经退开
lines.en: When you turned, I had already withdrawn.
You have one more cut.
My hands are cold.
I am close to your ear.
You looked the wrong way again.
I stay in the dark all along.
This one came from below.
You retreat; I retreat with you.
Do not breathe so heavily.
It only makes me want to strike.
I strike again.
This one used more force.
This eye of mine watches your back.
That is rare.
I pull back a little.
Watching you from the side.
Wait for one more chance.
The chance comes again.
The shadow moves first.

lines.zh: 我从墙角的暗处显出来
lines.en: I appear in the corner's dark.
A ring of eye white floats out.
The mist gathers here.
I have guarded this place all along.

lines.zh: 只是你没有看这个方向
lines.en: You simply did not look this way.

lines.zh: 我把身体的影子压得很低
lines.en: I press my body's shadow very low.
A patch of light on the ground dims.
I turn my head once.

lines.zh: 黑暗里先睁眼的总是我。
lines.en: In the dark, I am always the first to open my eyes.
I look over that way.
This is a good position.

lines.zh: 火照亮了暗处，我被看见了
lines.en: Fire lights the dark; I am seen.
I topple from the top of the wall.
Water drags me out of the mist.
The blast peels away the shadow.

lines.zh: 那东西擦着我的脸过去
lines.en: It grazed past my face.
That force made me visible.
Even watching makes one hungry.

lines.zh: 雷光把整片暗处都照亮
lines.en: Lightning lights all the dark.
There is no shadow to hide in here.
